identity.author: Bjornar Egede-Nissen (galloppinggryphon)
identity.description: Bedrock add-on with scripted, item-based world-editing tools (build, destroy, query, measure, teleport) driven by the /fill command, with a shift-key-activated in-game configuration GUI.

constraints: GPL-3.0 is copyleft: redistributed derivatives of the licensed code must remain GPL-3.0 and disclose source changes
The items/blocks/models/build-scripts subfolders are separately MIT-licensed by the author
The experimental_ui folder embeds third-party Mojang-distributed demonstration font/UI engine code under its own terms

scripts: EngToolsBP scripting engine tools driving the vanilla /fill command

uiElements: Shift-key-activated GUI for per-tool configuration (fill size, build direction, block selector)

manifestEvidence: README: item-based scripting engine tools requiring Holiday Creator Features and Additional Modding Capabilities experimental toggles
uiEvidence: Documented shift-key GUI for configuring fill size, build direction, and block selector

strongIndicators: Published LICENSE file with an explicit GPL-3.0 grant plus a documented MIT carve-out for asset subfolders
Detailed per-tool documentation with concrete usage instructions and known-issue tracking
weakIndicators: Single tagged release from 5 years ago; targets an old Bedrock version (1.17)
Windows-only, single-player, creative-mode-only; author marks it a preview that may be unstable
gaps: Source was not opened or copied; facts are README/file-listing-level only

implementationFacts.implementationPattern: Scripted item-based world-editing tools (fill/destroy/query/measure/teleport) driven by the vanilla /fill command, with a shift-key-activated in-game GUI for per-tool configuration
limitations: Windows-only (relies on the scripting and GUI engine; unavailable on mobile editions)
Single-player games only; creative mode only
Max supported fill volume is 32,768 blocks (x*y*z)
Custom blocks with custom states cannot be placed (documented Mojang engine limitation, MCPE-116750)
performanceCharacteristics: Large fills (tens of thousands of blocks) noticeably add to world save size and CPU cost per the author's own tips
runtimeHooks: Minecraft Bedrock scripting engine (Additional Modding Capabilities experimental toggle)
shift/sneak key repurposed to open tool configuration GUI
uiMethods: Shift-key-activated configuration GUI per equipped tool

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-09-11 against the public README, root file listing (LICENSE present), and the single v1.0.0 release tag.
Only README-level facts were used; no template source code or assets were copied into Hydraulic.
